description:
LANDED 8de517a28 on wt/kdt-close (PR #110, draft), 2026-09-03. Cold review with
prototype (approve-with-fixes, all folded) + adversarial refutation.
Test/doc-side only: git diff names drive_test.rs and dispatch-matrix.md; canon
and behaviour byte-identical by construction.

THE CHANGE: artifact_plans(program) enumerates every plan the artifact carries
-- FIVE kinds: call-edge dispatch (PlanSite::CallEdge{executable, callsite}),
executable entry dispatch (Entry), a `case` tail (Case), a `receive` tail
(Receive), and construction-wrapper member selection (Selection{wrapper},
wrapper.identity) -- each with its seated body order (call-arm list /
clause_ids / arm order / clause index / member index; the refuter found the
case and receive kinds, 70 + 86 plans corpus-wide, 0 blind pairs); seated_arm_surfaces reads
(plan, &[body_id]); dispatch_call_edges DELETED (the forwarded-lambda static-
key gate now asserts zero plans of ANY kind, measured true). A standing gate
pins that the list order and the decision graph's first-match order agree on
every plan (192 plans, 0 disagreements) -- the reviewer proved it by
construction (compile_ordered_arms is first-match over the list; add_row
emits one arm/one Unique outcome per row; the fz-kdt.108 weld outcomes[i].
body_id == i holds on every wrapper in the corpus). Census keys carry the
site. Entry, case and receive plans are SOURCE-ORDER sites: EXCLUDED from the
covering-seat gate (first-matching clause is the language's meaning:
entry_source_patterns mints body_id in source order and EntryReachability::
new sorts by it; the seat's cure would change the program) and INCLUDED in
the blind-escape census as their own class (SOURCE_ORDER_BLIND_ESCAPES = [],
SOURCE_ORDER_PLANS_ON_THE_CENSUS pins (kind, plans, unreadable) per kind:
entry 144 / 137 unreadable -- Region::List, TupleArity, Guard, Equal --, case
3 / 3, receive 2 / 0). SELECTION_SEAT_ALLOWANCE: 21 rows / 73 findings
attributed to fz-kdt.179 (00277 w10 2, w11 2, w13-w19 8 each, w20 2;
enum_hof_three_distinct_closures w3/w4/w5 1 each; 00420 and behavior/
enum_take_drop_split w21-w24 1 each -- the two fixtures the first cut held
out on a number that does not exist). The blind-escape population is SPLIT:
BLIND_ESCAPE_POPULATION 45 reachable selection readings + the 3 call-edge
pairs of 131, BLIND_ESCAPE_UNREACHABLE_PAIRS 28 (00277 w13-w19, 4 each: pairs
whose tests are DISJOINT at subject 0, a covers position-wise imprecision,
fz-kdt.186). INDISTINGUISHABLE_ARM_POPULATION: one-question groups ALL on
wrapper selections (00277 47, enum_map_family 46, 00420 12, ...) -- call-
edge, entry, case and receive offer none. ARM_ORDER_CENSUS 15 -> 22; the
"DELIBERATE SUBSET" paragraph is gone; 281 plans, 0 graph-order
disagreements.
Per-setting: arms:1..5 = 68 pairs byte-identical, arms:6 = 70; selection
readings invariant under every arm seed (a wrapper-order axis); only one of
the two arms:6 extras is reachable (executable 203) -- the other is 186's.

CORRECTED: the "w2" attribution shipped by fz-kdt.144 (its commit, the
SURFACE_MEMBERSHIP_CENSUS doc, dispatch-matrix.md, tickets 178/179) was
never measured -- the tripwire prints no wrapper id (fz-kdt.187); the ten
escaping wrappers are w10, w11, w20 (four members) and w13-w19 (eleven).

RED-FIRST at base (walk widened, constants untouched): seats_the_covering_arm
fails with 62 entries on 00277's w10/w11/w13-w20; offers_no_runtime_
indistinguishable_arm fails on 00420 with 12; blind_escape_census left 65 vs
right 3.

REFUTER'S CORRECTIONS folded: the case/receive kinds; the two held-out
fixtures admitted (their "215 unreachable readings" was 0 -- they carry 4
REACHABLE seat findings each, byte-identical under every arm seed, now
pinned); a doc sentence claiming call-edge plans put one question each
(they put two; a call-edge unreachable pair exists at executable 201).
Reachable seat coverage: 45 of the corpus's 45. Reader gaps found and
ticketed (fz-kdt.193): the census compares subject MAPS and skips pairs asking
different subject sets where production walks the full vector; separating
subjects are read from the earlier arm only; dump wrapper numbers differ
from census wrapper numbers.

Gate wall clocks: census 83.5s, seat 13.6s, twins 10.3s, order-agreement
13.3s (fixture count, not the walk: ~31 ms/pass vs ~9.8 s of compilation).
COORDINATOR GATE (fresh, marker COORD-GATE-1788419704, HEAD 8de517a28): fmt clean; build 0 warnings; clippy -D warnings clean; lib 1613 passed / 0 failed / 5 ignored (221 s -- the census gates now drive 22 fixtures x 7 arrivals); fixture_matrix --test-threads=1 485 / 0 / 9 (known-red set unchanged).

comments.text: THE DYNAMIC HALF IS LIVE (fz-kdt.144, 0889c0b3a), and it confirms this ticket's premise by measurement. 00277_enum_tier0_fixture is in ARM_ORDER_CENSUS, the static blind-escape census reports nothing for it, and the tripwire reads 12 escapes on it at the settled arrival -- values reaching wrapper w2's list(int) member with [1, :tail], [3, 1, :tail], [5, 3, 1, :tail] (4 each), each report naming the element that broke it. That is precisely the surface dispatch_call_edges never walks. Reproducer: FZ_STRESS_ASSERT_SURFACE_MEMBERSHIP=1 fz2 interp fixtures2/00277_enum_tier0_fixture.fz 2>&1 >/dev/null | grep -c 'surface-membership escape' -> 12. Use it as the acceptance oracle for the widened static walk: after this ticket the static census must report the same 00277 wrapper-selection escape the dynamic one already sees. .agent/docs/dispatch-matrix.md's static-census section now says the two instruments see different subsets and why.

title: The static census walks every plan the artifact carries: call-edge dispatch, entry dispatch and wrapper selection, each finding named by its site
